Differentiate sums termwise, but do not obtain product or quotient derivatives by simply multiplying or dividing the individual derivatives. Rewriting radicals or denominators as powers must preserve the original domain restrictions.

Inputs with zero denominator are excluded from the original function. \[N=9,\quad N^{\prime}=0\]\[D=5 v^{3},\quad D^{\prime}=15 v^{2}\]\[\frac{d}{dv}\frac ND=\frac{N^{\prime}D-ND^{\prime}}{D^2}=\frac{0 \cdot 5 v^{3} - 9 \cdot 15 v^{2}}{25 v^{6}}\]

Differentiate sums termwise, but do not obtain product or quotient derivatives by simply multiplying or dividing the individual derivatives. Rewriting radicals or denominators as powers must preserve the original domain restrictions.

First expand products or divide the fraction term by term. Differentiate this sum of powers without using product or quotient rules. \[\frac{r^{\frac{5}{2}} + 3 r^{\frac{3}{2}}}{r}=r^{\frac{3}{2}} + 3 \sqrt{r}\]

Differentiate each term and add. Constant terms vanish and constant coefficients remain. \[\frac{d}{dr}\left(r^{\frac{3}{2}}\right)=\frac{3 \sqrt{r}}{2}\]\[\frac{d}{dr}\left(3 \sqrt{r}\right)=\frac{3}{2 \sqrt{r}}\]

\[U=2 x^{2} + 1,\ U\prime=4 x;\quad V=- x^{2} + x,\ V\prime=1 - 2 x\]

For this composite power, differentiate the outer power and multiply by the inner derivative: \[u=x^{2},\quad \frac{du}{dx}=2 x\]\[\frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac{1}{x^{2}}\right)=- \frac{2 x}{x^{4}}\]

ko: 접점이 \((a,f(a))\)이고 기울기가 유한하면 접선은 \(y-f(a)=f^{\prime}(a)(x-a)\)이다. 먼저 원래 함수에서 접점의 높이를 구하고 도함수에서 기울기를 구분해 읽는다. 법선 기울기 \(-1/m\)은 \(m\ne0\)일 때만 쓰며, 수평 접선의 법선은 수직선이다.

분자와 분모를 따로 미분한 뒤 몫의 미분법에 대입한다. 분모가 0인 입력은 원래 함수에서 제외한다. \[N=2 x,\quad N^{\prime}=2\]\[D=x + 1,\quad D^{\prime}=1\]\[\frac{d}{dx}\frac ND=\frac{N^{\prime}D-ND^{\prime}}{D^2}=\frac{\left(-1\right) 2 x 1 + 2 \left(x + 1\right)}{\left(x + 1\right)^{2}}\]

Differentiate the numerator and denominator separately, then substitute into the quotient rule. Inputs with zero denominator are excluded from the original function. \[N=2 x,\quad N^{\prime}=2\]\[D=x + 1,\quad D^{\prime}=1\]\[\frac{d}{dx}\frac ND=\frac{N^{\prime}D-ND^{\prime}}{D^2}=\frac{\left(-1\right) 2 x 1 + 2 \left(x + 1\right)}{\left(x + 1\right)^{2}}\]

For this composite power, differentiate the outer power and multiply by the inner derivative: \[u=x + 1,\quad \frac{du}{dx}=1\]\[\frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac{1}{x + 1}\right)=\left(-1\right) \frac{1}{\left(x + 1\right)^{2}} \cdot 1\]

분자와 분모를 따로 미분한 뒤 몫의 미분법에 대입한다. 분모가 0인 입력은 원래 함수에서 제외한다. \[N=x - 1,\quad N^{\prime}=1\]\[D=x + 1,\quad D^{\prime}=1\]\[\frac{d}{dx}\frac ND=\frac{N^{\prime}D-ND^{\prime}}{D^2}=\frac{\left(-1\right) \left(x - 1\right) 1 + 1 \left(x + 1\right)}{\left(x + 1\right)^{2}}\]

Differentiate the numerator and denominator separately, then substitute into the quotient rule. Inputs with zero denominator are excluded from the original function. \[N=x - 1,\quad N^{\prime}=1\]\[D=x + 1,\quad D^{\prime}=1\]\[\frac{d}{dx}\frac ND=\frac{N^{\prime}D-ND^{\prime}}{D^2}=\frac{\left(-1\right) \left(x - 1\right) 1 + 1 \left(x + 1\right)}{\left(x + 1\right)^{2}}\]

For this composite power, differentiate the outer power and multiply by the inner derivative: \[u=x + 1,\quad \frac{du}{dx}=1\]\[\frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac{1}{x + 1}\right)=\left(-1\right) \frac{1}{\left(x + 1\right)^{2}} \cdot 1\]
At each contact point use y−f(a)=m(x−a).
